findings.finding: The inherited hrd-testing summary conflated standalone LOH with the composite LOH+TAI+LST score. The corrected summary distinguishes them without making a new brand-specific claim.
Signature3 is measured in tumour DNA,not a direct functional protein assay.HRDetect is a genomic classifier;RAD51 is a functional surrogate with specimen and assay conditions.

Blanket treatment-sensitivity and permanent-scar claims were removed from the lead,summary,strengths and limitations.Telli has no nonplatinum comparator;Cruz separates PARP and cisplatin response in selected models.

The Telli manuscript uses greater-than42 in some passages and at-least42 in the Discussion.The new overview uses no numeric threshold;the already qualified scar-score owner preserves that discrepancy and is unchanged.
Cruz introduces scar persistence as cited background,not an experiment measuring scar persistence.The new overview avoids an absolute permanent-scar assertion.

The inherited standard-of-care technology status groups clinical gene/scar testing with research RAD51 discussion.It is preserved,not recertified as universal approval of every assay;the reader requires assay-specific clinical validation.

The English simple summary repeated a treatment-success promise and was corrected.The eight machine-translation tables and existing linked-card/schematic labels retain their own evidence and language scope;this correction does not confer native-language,product or connected-card acceptance.
